definitions_checked.AdmissibleOn: For every vertex, class and shore: twice class-cut size <= cut size
definitions_checked.Compatible: No class occurs on two selected copies incident to one vertex
definitions_checked.IsCircuit: Nonempty; degree two on support; every nonempty proper support cut is nonempty
definitions_checked.classCutOn: Crossing copies incident to the tested vertex with its tested class
definitions_checked.cutOn: Actual copies with exactly one endpoint in the shore
definitions_checked.degreeOn: Number of selected incident actual copies
